_readme: Default shipped state: an EMPTY room. Never ship a populated verdict — a new install would open on a stranger's case. The sitting flow overwrites this file; the four states are empty | convening | reading | verdict.

empty.headline: What's the sales problem?
empty.qask: Eight advisers · every quote real and deep-linked · one verdict you can act on today
empty.cases_label: The kind of decision the board rules on
cases: "Champion insists he has authority, but every answer needs 'checking with the team.' Take him at his word or ask who really decides?"
"My guarantee is scaring off buyers who assume it means the product's weak. Cut it or explain it better?"
"Deal's been verbally agreed for a week with no signature. Call and ask for it directly or send a gentle nudge email?"
"Large deal, four meetings in, and I still haven't asked what happens if they do nothing. Ask it cold in meeting five or ease in?"
"A prospect said 'call me anytime' three calls ago, then went quiet. Do I take him literally or read the silence?"
